text:
CLASSIFICATION::username
Description
This command returns username associated with classification results.
Syntax
CLASSIFICATION
::
username
Examples
In the example, the CLASSIFICATION::username command returns username.
when
CLASSIFICATION_DETECTED
{
set
res
[
CLASSIFICATION
::
username
]
log
local0.debug
"DPI username: $res"
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
CLASSIFICATION_DETECTED
